claims.text: Prochlorperazine for severe nausea/vomiting (adult oral): usually 5 mg or 10 mg 3 or 4 times daily; above 40 mg/day only in resistant cases.
claims.quote: Usually one 5 mg or 10 mg tablet 3 or 4 times daily. Daily dosages above 40 mg should be used only in resistant cases.

claims.text: Boxed warning: increased death in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotics.
claims.quote: Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of death.
claims.locator: Boxed Warning › Increased Mortality in Elderly Patients with Dementia-Related Psychosis

claims.quote: Tardive dyskinesia, a syndrome consisting of potentially irreversible, involuntary, dyskinetic movements, may develop in patients treated with antipsychotic drugs.

claims.text: and potentially fatal neuroleptic malignant syndrome (hyperpyrexia, rigidity, altered mental status, autonomic instability) has been reported.
claims.quote: A potentially fatal syndrome complex sometimes referred to as Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS) has been reported in association with antipsychotic drugs. Clinical manifestations of NMS are hyperpyrexia, muscle rigidity, altered mental status and evidence of autonomic instability

claims.text: CI: comatose states, or large amounts of CNS depressants (alcohol, barbiturates, opioids).
claims.quote: Do not use in comatose states or in the presence of large amounts of central nervous system depressants (alcohol, barbiturates, narcotics, etc.).
